item.title: Postgres.app 3beta2
item.description:
PostgreSQL beta versions usually introduce incompatible on-disk data formats.

Do not install this update if you need to access databases created with PostgreSQL 19beta1, 19beta2, 19beta3 or 19beta4.

If you want to keep your 19beta servers, be sure to dump your databases before installing this upgrade.

Servers created with 19rc1 are compatible with 19rc2.

  • PostgreSQL 14.25 with PostGIS 3.2.10
  • PostgreSQL 15.20 with PostGIS 3.3.10
  • PostgreSQL 16.16 with PostGIS 3.4.6
  • PostgreSQL 17.12 with PostGIS 3.5.6
  • PostgreSQL 18.7 with PostGIS 3.6.3
  • PostgreSQL 19rc2 with PostGIS 3.7.0

This will likely be the final update for PostgreSQL 14 before it reaches the end of its support period. Please update to a newer version as soon as possible.

You can find more info on the Github Releases Page.
